call_points.text: Lifetime sales for Enmetazobactam are estimated between $1 billion to $2 billion.
The company outlined a ₹750 Cr capital expenditure for 7-ACA and downstream integration with 1,000 MT total capacity, scheduled to commission in FY27.
Management plans to launch 5 to 6 sterile products in the US market by 2030.
The merger with Dhanuka Laboratories is nearing completion to unify R&D, eliminate duplication, and simplify the balance sheet.

guidance.statement: Plans to launch 5-6 sterile products in the US by 2030
Lifetime sales for Enmetazobactam would be between $1 billion to $2 billion overall during the life of the patent.

operating_notes.text: Entire net QIP proceeds of ₹391.8 Cr received and utilized up to ₹332.56 Cr as of March 31, 2026, with ₹61.98 Cr kept in fixed deposits.
Completed acquisition of 100% assets of Allecra Therapeutics GmbH and Allecra Therapeutics SAS, securing 100% global ownership of novel antibiotic Enmetazobactam.
Total capital expenditure outlay of ₹1,015 Cr planned across 7-ACA integration (₹750 Cr), Cefiderocol access project (₹200 Cr), FDF capability (₹50 Cr), and R&D/pipeline (₹15 Cr).
Enmetazobactam treated about 30,000 patients in the last year.
Board approved enabling resolution to explore raising funds up to ₹600 Cr via QIP, preferential issue, private placement, or public issue.
Entered into a licensing and supply agreement with Laboratorio Libra S.A. for Exblifep across nine Latin American markets with a 10-year potential opportunity of USD 80 million.

timeline.summary: Dhanuka Laboratories Ltd’s **Kunal Verma** declares no new encumbrances on Orchid Pharma shares for FY2025-26, confirming prior disclosures.
Orchid Pharma released its investor presentation detailing its growth strategy, ₹1,015 Cr capital allocation plan, and 7-ACA integration progress.
Orchid Pharma held its Q4 FY26 earnings call on May 26, 2026, updating on the 7-ACA project and Enmetazobactam out-licensing progress.
On June 5, 2026, NCLT Chennai sanctioned the scheme of amalgamation of Dhanuka Laboratories Limited with Orchid Pharma Limited.
Board approved an enabling resolution to raise up to ₹600 Cr via equity, convertible debentures, or debt securities.
Orchid Pharma signed a licensing and supply agreement with Laboratorio Libra to expand Exblifep into nine Latin American markets.
